summary.content:
Today's selection covers 105 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 72 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI boom could trigger market shocks, Bank of England boss warns
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Warlock Ransomware Hits Large Spanish, Portuguese Orgs
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, Dark Reading, The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
